explanation.headline: FDA shortage list shows Pfizer Inc. verapamil hydrochloride injection discontinued as of 2025-11-21; our current label names Proficient Rx LP with VAI inspections in 2015 and 2022

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list records Pfizer Inc. verapamil hydrochloride injection as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-21.
Our current product label identifies Proficient Rx LP as the labeler and plant (FEI 3011557028) for NDC 63187084930.
FDA inspection records for that plant show a VAI classification on 2015-10-22 (known 2016-01-20) and another VAI on 2022-12-08 (known 2023-02-08).
Corvale East has 22 days on hand at current use and Corvale General has 31 days on hand.

rejected.text: The best option by rule is to buy from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
Check whether A-S Medication Solutions can confirm a manufacturing site and current supply reliability before committing.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-bc05c8.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%verapamil%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%verapamil%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-716ae2.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('19cb23bd-cc6d-45fc-a1fc-b4130ea460a6') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-f20da0.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%verapamil%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-7b5736.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%verapamil%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-5cc387.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%verapamil%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-5a2a45.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3011557028') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-8c11bc.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3011557028') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-2ac723.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3011557028') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('proficient rx')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-ce1bc6.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('proficient rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%verapamil%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-995558.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('63187084930')

Q-4212a0.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%verapamil%'
